notes.title: Ace demo is live!
notes.notes:
[h2]"What's in the demo?"[/h2]

The demo offers a brief look at our story mode and the current state of our unique level generator.

[h2]"A level generator? Tell me more!"[/h2]
Using either the basic or advanced menu, you will be able to set the weights of environment tiles, as well as character speed, gravity, and so on. 

Naming the level acts as a randomizer for our fancy algorithm to add a bit of spice. 

The weights and name combined are your level seed, which can be imported for others to experience the same level with the same settings you generated.

With this, the demo is basically infinite.

[h2]"I have feedback for you!"[/h2]
That's great to hear and the reason why we are launching a demo. We feel that we don't want to release as early access, but we still wanted to give the world something to play as soon as we could! Hence, the demo is a good snapshot of where we are in our current development, and getting feedback to us will help us shape what the final game looks like.

So, you can jump into our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2945390/]Steam Community[/url], or send us a message in-game using the feedback tab in the settings menu

It feels so good to be able to share this with you - thanks for being here, and we can't wait to hear from you!
